requirements: R1: Resolve the backup container failure caused by directory mapping errors for the backup script
R2: Resolve the backend container failure caused by a Flyway migration error where the strains table does not exist

slices.title: Resolve runtime initialization errors in backend and backup containers
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to resolve the docker container initialization errors, so that the environment starts correctly and passes health checks
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backup container starts
When it tries to run the backup script
Then the script executes successfully without directory errors
Given the backend container starts
When Flyway migrations run
Then all migrations including the strains table update apply successfully in the correct order
